title: ATV Optimizer
shortDescription: Debloat Android TV and Google TV. A power-user toolkit on your phone, no PC.
fullDescription:
Debloat, tune and manage your Android TV, Google TV or NVIDIA SHIELD from your phone over Wi-Fi. No PC needed.

More than a debloater: a power-user toolkit for launchers, hidden settings, sideloading, file transfer and live diagnostics.

• Debloat with reviewed safety labels, and re-enable apps any time
• Swap out the stock launcher where your TV's firmware allows
• Tweak animation speed, HDMI-CEC, frame-rate matching and Private DNS
• Sideload APKs, move files both ways and send text from the remote
• Watch live temps, RAM and storage, and read HDR and codec support
• Save your setup as a snapshot (Beta) and reapply it later

Know what is safe
Every cataloged app carries a reviewed label: Safe to remove, Caution or Protected. Protected apps are blocked. Unreviewed apps are labeled Unknown, never Safe to remove. Review the plan before anything changes.

Free
• Connect and check your TV before you buy
• Browse apps with their safety labels, RAM and storage
• Live diagnostics, TV screenshots and a remote with text entry
• File transfer, APK installs and APK backups
• Re-enable apps and run Emergency recovery, which turns every disabled app back on

Pro, a one-time purchase with no subscription
• Disable or uninstall apps and apply an Optimize plan
• Set a new Home app and disable the stock launcher
• Change TV settings
• Snapshots (Beta). Restoring a snapshot disables apps and restores settings; it never re-enables or reinstalls apps.
Undoing settings, Home app or snapshot changes needs Pro. Emergency recovery re-enables disabled apps only.

What you need
• An Android TV or Google TV on the same network as your phone
• Developer options with Network debugging or Wireless debugging turned on
• Your approval on the TV's debugging prompt
Support varies by TV and firmware. Fire TV isn't supported. Changing system apps can affect how your TV behaves, so change only what you understand.

Privacy
Saved TVs, app lists, snapshots, screenshots and files stay on your phone or local network. Optional device and error reports are on by default, with a notice and an opt-out in More > Privacy. They include TV model, software versions, a random installation ID, action outcomes and redacted errors. They never include TV serial numbers, network addresses, TV names or app lists. The privacy policy in the app covers retention and deletion.

ATV Optimizer is an independent app, not affiliated with or endorsed by Google or NVIDIA. Android TV and Google TV are trademarks of Google LLC. SHIELD is a trademark of NVIDIA Corporation.
